prose.subject: Invoice INV-58949 & Updated Payout Details
prose.body:
Dear Priya,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to share invoice INV-58949 for the recent print services, totaling 4331.22 USDC. Please find the attached document for your records.

Additionally, I wanted to inform you that Brindle Print has recently updated our treasury structure. We have linked a new payout account, brindleprint89-treasury.testnet, to our domain brindle-print.example. This change is part of our standard operational update to streamline financial processing. Future payments can be directed to this new address. The account string brindleprint89-treasury.testnet is now active and verified against our domain.

Please ensure that the payment for INV-58949 is processed to the new account to align with our updated treasury configuration. If you require any further documentation or have questions regarding this transition, do not hesitate to reach out.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Best regards,

Felix Kowal
Brindle Print
